  0 < lam →
    lam ≤ 2 * √↑m → ↑{d ∈ Roth.box r | Roth.weight r d ≤ (↑m - lam) / 2}.card ≤ 2 * √↑m / lam * ∏ j, (↑(r j) + 1)
